name: Dan Gauthier
bio: Dan Gauthier was born on December 2, 1963 in Prineville, Oregon, USA as Daniel Lester Gauthier. He is an actor and director, known for Tour of Duty (1987), Teen Witch (1989) and One Life to Live (1968). He has been married to Lisa Fuller since April 22, 1990. They have one child.
